stories.title: Scheffler opens playoffs with dominant 8-shot win
stories.summary: Scottie Scheffler was back to his dominant form Sunday, winning the FedEx St. Jude Championship by eight shots to open the PGA Tour postseason.

stories.title: Pitcher, surgery pioneer Tommy John dies at 83
stories.summary: Former major league pitcher Tommy John, the namesake behind the pioneering elbow surgery that prolonged his career for 14 more years, has died at the age of 83.

stories.title: Retired Donald works out for Rams for 2nd time
stories.summary: Aaron Donald worked out for the Los Angeles Rams on Saturday as he continues his process to determine whether he wants to come out of retirement.

stories.title: Mariota has MCL sprain; Week 1 return expected
stories.summary: Commanders quarterback Marcus Mariota suffered a sprained right knee and will miss the rest of the preseason, but he is expected to be ready for the regular-season opener.

stories.title: Kittle eyes return to practice, opener in Australia
stories.summary: George Kittle, who suffered a torn Achilles in January, said he might be able to practice soon with the hope that he'll be ready for the 49ers' opener vs. the Rams.
